character.name: 行脚郎中 / travelling physician
character.desc: Kind middle-aged Chinese man with short black beard, blue-grey cloth headwrap and patched blue-grey robe, cream crossing collar, straw sandals, large wicker herb basket on back with green leaves, medicine pouches and bandage roll. Holds a short wooden medicine pestle for modest defensive sweep. Robust approachable healer silhouette.
character.special: emergency aid sequence, reach into herb bag, prepare herb bundle and unfurl white bandage then offer it

visual_review: Selected after full-source visual inspection; exported idle, move, attack, special and independent head subsequently inspected. All body frames independently drawn; hit reuses reviewed idle poses.
